Methodology & sources

Data source

Derived from the TX Physician Private Practice dataset (NPPES NPI Registry + CMS Doctors & Clinicians + Medicare Physician & Other Practitioners + PECOS). This radar filters that universe to solo and small practices (estimated practice size ≤ 3) with at least $5,000 of Medicare payment, then scores them.

Transition-target score (0–100)

Base 30, plus NPI tenure (years since NPI enumeration; 15+ scores highest), solo-proprietor status (+25 — the prime relationship and the most likely to transition), Medicare scale (practice viability), and an established/mature practice flag.

Important limitation

Public data does not include physician age or actual practice-opening date, so true retirement/succession timing cannot be observed. Tenure is proxied by NPI enumeration date (the registry began in 2005–2007, capping observable tenure ~20 years). Treat this as a directional solo-practice target list, not a retirement forecast — confirm intent through outreach.

Refresh: python succession/refresh.py — re-derives from the physician dataset. Updates when that dataset is refreshed.
